Name: Hispanic George
Author: AllegedMexican
Description:
George is now Jorge... well he's still [i]George[/i] but he's Hispanic now.

I will forever be disappointed by the lack of POC representation in Stardew Valley, so I decided to do something about it. The first on my list was George. I took some inspiration from the Mexican side of my family when redoing his look, so he has darker skin, neater hair, and a sweet mustache. I also cleaned up the stains on his shirt and wheel chair because he deserves better.

[u]Installation:[/u]
[list=1]
[*]Back up your files [s]or don't I'm not the file police[/s]

[*]Unzip and place the files in the content folder, let it overwrite anything that it needs to

[*]Enjoy the Hispanic man milling around Stardew Valley

[/list]
Please don't repost without my permission. Suggestions of more POC edits are always appreciated :)
